title: PanelStatesFile
description:
`panel-states.yaml`: the starting points a pilot can pick on the Start page, each with
the steps it counts as already done or skipped.

states.description: The states, in the picker's order.

PanelState.description: A ready-made point to start from, with earlier steps already accounted for.

description.description: What it starts from, in words. The app does not show it today.

done.description:
Steps ticked when this state is chosen, unless already ticked or skipped; choosing
another state takes those ticks back.

id.description: The state's id, which a flight records and aliases can rename.

skip.description:
Steps skipped when this state is chosen, unless already ticked or skipped; choosing
another state takes those skips back.

title.description: Its name in the Start page's panel-state picker.

StepId.description:
A stable step id: `<pack-id>.<phase>.<short-name>`, e.g. `demo-aircraft.preflight.irs-mode`.
An id never changes once published, even if the step is reworded or moved to another phase.
